description: This file defines command-line interface commands related to microphone management within a larger application. It includes commands to list available microphone input devices and to set a default input device index, utilizing AVFoundation for hardware discovery.

classes.name: MicCommand
classes.description: Defines the main command 'mic' with subcommands for listing and setting microphone devices.

classes.name: MicList
classes.description: Implements listing available microphone input devices asynchronously.

classes.name: MicSet
classes.description: Implements setting the default microphone input device index, optionally using a configuration file.

methods.name: commandDescription
methods.description: Provides command metadata for help and CLI parsing.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the listing of audio capture devices or sets the device index based on user input.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializers for the command structures, setting up properties based on parsed arguments.
